scope: Local docker-vm profile; not production, hosted, cross-cloud, or all-OS qualification

source.algorithm: SHA256 of sorted UTF-8 path + NUL + file SHA256 + newline entries

platform.host: macOS Apple Silicon aarch64; nested virtualization
platform.runtime: Kata 4.3.1 runtime-rs / Dragonball; no Go Kata fallback

checks.coverage_scope: All own implementation modules; generated/build/test-source files excluded; host execution instrumentation, Linux node-only branches are not instrumented
checks.fresh_official_cli: pass: four 16 MiB uploads, five matching downloads, executable mode, concurrent commands, Dockerfile RUN, two Compose services, preview HTTP 200, stop/start, fresh random marker persistence, deletion
checks.guest_root_network: 21 checks passed including direct IPv4/IPv6/UDP/DNS/metadata/sibling denial, spoofing, guest firewall replacement, broker allow/deny, private DNS and active stream revocation
checks.storage_resources: private 2 GiB block root; no shared filesystem or host bind mounts; agent device read-only; block zeroing and disk end enforced; host CPU/memory/swap/oom controls observed
checks.independent_lifetime: 90-second lease, creator exited, watchdog terminated VM at original deadline, restart rejected
checks.security_review: Independent read-only review: no critical/high findings in final cleanup, restart, lifecycle and boundary delta

unsupported: Selective native guest filesystem/process/executable identity enforcement against guest root
Native credential injection, L7/middleware policies not implemented by this profile
Production crash recovery, multi-tenant load/exhaustion and launcher-replacement matrix
Windows, native Linux launcher, x86, hosted and cross-cloud qualification
Production PTY/JWT-refresh/reconnect and durable backup support

delivery.publication: blocked: no repository remote or release target configured
delivery.cleanup: Task-owned services, guest resources, VM and instrumented cache removed after reports; private local credentials preserved
